findings.observation: Forward guardrail for `UOW-03` (`Gutzwiller D_j=+1 VMC projection stability check across staggered SU(2)_R / flux sectors`): because `G_j^{v2} P_+ = 0`, any site-dependent `SU(2)_R` gauge rotation `O_s = exp(theta_s . SO4_L)` in `(-c, b)` basis leaves `P_Gutz |Psi_MF(O A O^T)>` invariant up to a global phase (verified on 8-site torus: `|1 - fid| = 2.22e-16`, `cond = 2.621` including worst-case `exp(pi SO4_L^{x,y,z})`). However, `kitaev-mf`'s unprojected Kitaev decoupling `build_bond_hopping_matrices` (`2 J_b^{ab} N^a U_b N^b` with `N^a = R^a - L^a`) satisfies `[L^b, N^a] = +eps_{abc} L^c != 0`, breaking continuous `SU(2)_R -> Z_2` (sublattice-staggered `O_A U O_B^T` drops Gutzwiller overlap to `0.697311`, whereas pure-spin `R^a U R^b` decoupling is `SU(2)_R`-covariant to `5.55e-17`). In `UOW-03`, test staggered `SU(2)_R` invariance via direct quadratic conjugation `A -> O A O^T` (probing `build_thouless_data` reference conditioning & VMC sampling variance) rather than feeding `SU(2)_R`-rotated `(U, V)` into `N^a` hopping, and note that `gutzwiller_projection.py:torus_bonds` uses `(+1,0)`/`(0,+1)` `kitaev-numerics` offsets when adding `flipped_bonds` / vison-sector support.

Improper `O(4)` Pfaffian parity law & site positivity diamond: because `det(P_0) = -1`, `Pf(P_0^{oplus N} A P_0^{oplus N}) = (-1)^N Pf(A)` (verified for `N = 1..5`). Thus single-site Gaussian parity satisfies `<D_s>_G = -Pf(V_s^{kmf}) = +Pf(V_s^{v2})`, even-`N` periodic tori preserve global Pfaffian sign (`(-1)^{2 L^2} = +1`), and odd-active-site vacancy clusters (`N_active = 2 L^2 - n_vac` odd in `UOW-05` disorder runs) negate active-subspace Pfaffians across `P_0`. Additionally, every physical 1-site covariance obeys the exact spectral norm identity `||V_s||_2 = 2*(||<S_s>|| + ||<G_s^{v2}>||) <= 1` (`< 1e-14`), which can be exposed as a parameter-free physicality check on `SiteSU2Decomposition`.
